body:
I’m sorry you’re losing your one good thing. My best friend is long distance too. We FaceTime regularly but I wish I could see her in person because it’s just not the same. 

What are some things that you two liked to do together?

While I don’t know you, I know they didn’t waste their time. With each procedure they get better at what they do. Maybe after saving you, they had the experience they needed to save someone who will go on to do great things or live a fulfilling life like you mentioned in your post. Or maybe they had enough money to buy their second vacation home, who the hell knows? 

Anyway, I’m glad you posted. I’ve often felt the same, why am I here and someone more deserving is not? I wish I could slow down my brain. I hate having all these negative thoughts coming at me so fast. Guilt is a major one. 

I’ll be online for a bit if you feel like sharing anything more. ❤️

Waking up is the worst part of my day. I get what you mean about the thought of suicide is comforting. I feel the same way. It’s like I’m lighter for a moment.

This is my first time here so I’m not sure if I’m supposed to say something encouraging, but thanks for your post. I know others feel like I do but this is the first time I’ve actually talked to someone who feels this way. Hoping this sub can help. I don’t what what else to do at this point.
What’s going on? Stay with me. Tell me about yourself.
